max_pressure.docs:
**int or float**: Maximum pressure for the pressure sensor.

*See also: [Honeywell ABP 2 Pressure Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/honeywellabp2_i2c#configuration-variables)*

min_pressure.docs:
**int or float**: Minimum pressure for the pressure sensor.

*See also: [Honeywell ABP 2 Pressure Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/honeywellabp2_i2c#configuration-variables)*

transfer_function.docs:
**"A" or "B"**: Transfer function used by the pressure sensor.

*See also: [Honeywell ABP 2 Pressure Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/honeywellabp2_i2c#configuration-variables)*

pressure.docs:
The information for the pressure sensor.

*See also: [Honeywell ABP 2 Pressure Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/honeywellabp2_i2c#configuration-variables)*

temperature.docs:
The information for the temperature sensor. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [Honeywell ABP 2 Pressure Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/honeywellabp2_i2c#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [Honeywell ABP 2 Pressure Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/honeywellabp2_i2c#configuration-variables)*
